Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and lead cross-functional teams effectively
Excellent organizational, leadership, and communication skills
Proficiency with construction management software and project management tools
Experience working in the Middle East, particularly Saudi Arabia, is advantageous
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent is preferred
Demonstrated ability to deliver projects on time and within budget while maintaining quality standards

d: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Accountant with Logistics experience to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for end-to-end accounting operations, financial reporting, and ensuring strong financial controls in line with company budgets and regulatory requirements. This role plays a key part in overseeing general accounting functions, managing payables and receivables, supporting audits, and ensuring compliance with UAE VAT and Corporate Tax regulations, contributing to efficient and compliant financial operations across the business.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Commerce.
Professional certification (CPA, ACCA, or equivalent) is an added advantage.
Minimum 5 years of accounting experience; experience in logistics & freight forwarding is a strong advantage.
Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting and UAE tax regulations.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel (Macros & pivot tables) and accounting software (e.g., Sage 300,NetSuite, Oracle or similar).

Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to meet deadlines and work under pressure; proactive, detail-oriented, and independent; with high integrity and a strong commitment to confidentiality.
Applicant residing in the Emirate of Dubai is preferred.
